headerIdentity.title: Name your template
headerIdentity.description: Set the template name and category here — this is how you will find it again in the gallery.

headerSave.title: Save template
headerSave.description: Names and saves the template explicitly. Use it whenever you want a checkpoint you control, not just the autosave.

headerStatus.title: Autosave status
headerStatus.description: Your work saves automatically as you go. This shows the state: Draft, Saving…, Autosaved, or Unsaved changes if something has not synced yet.

toolbarViews.title: Edit or preview
toolbarViews.description: Switch between the editor and a preview of the finished email.

viewportScreenSize.title: Desktop or mobile
viewportScreenSize.description: Preview how the email renders on desktop or mobile. Some blocks let you set different values for each, so check both before you send.

toolbarHistory.title: Undo anytime
toolbarHistory.description: Every change can be undone or redone, so feel free to experiment.

libraryRail.title: Blocks, one click away
libraryRail.description: The most common blocks live here — drag any of them onto the canvas.

libraryTabs.title: Blocks and templates
libraryTabs.description: This panel groups blocks and full templates so you can start from scratch or from a layout.

blocksBasics.title: Basics
blocksBasics.description: Single-purpose blocks — text, image, button, divider, spacer, and social. Drag one onto the canvas, or click it to append it.

blocksLayout.title: Structure
blocksLayout.description: Columns and containers arrange the other blocks inside them. This is how you build an email that survives every client.

libraryTemplates.title: Templates
libraryTemplates.description: A gallery of complete templates — start from one instead of a blank canvas. Applying one replaces what is on the canvas.

canvasRoot.title: The canvas
canvasRoot.description: Click a block to select it, or drag one in from the library to add it.

canvasTextBlock.title: Edit text right on the canvas
canvasTextBlock.description: Click the text to start typing — a formatting toolbar appears while you edit.

inspectorPanel.title: Edit the selected block
inspectorPanel.description: Once a block is selected, its content and style options appear here.

inspectorTabs.title: Content and Styles
inspectorTabs.description: This panel has two tabs for the selected block: Content (what it says) and Styles (how it looks).

imageSources.title: Add images
imageSources.description: Pick an image from your workspace library, search Unsplash, or upload your own.

commandPalette.title: Everything from the keyboard
commandPalette.description: Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) to search and run any editor action without the mouse.

headerActions.title: Test and save
headerActions.description: Send yourself a test email before saving, so you know exactly what subscribers will get.
